        "Read all eight owned paths and the complete diff.         "The backend assigns config.outgoing = config.incoming, then sets addThisServer. These are the same object, so this is reuse rather than a clone. The older outgoing-derivation lesson is reused rather than duplicated.",
        "The Account Hub incomingConfigSubview now selects the Exchange branch through isExchangeConfig rather than only incoming.type == ews.
